entities.name: Saurmag I of Iberia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sauromaces I was a king (mepe) of Kartli listed as the second king in the traditional royal list of medieval Georgian chronicles. Professor Toumanoff suggest the years 234–159 BC as the period of his reign.
